offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures IV infusion systems, disposable IV consumables and injectable drugs, selling them to hospitals and alternate-site care providers, which use them to deliver fluids, medications and therapies to patients.

primary_products.value: IV solution sets and connectors; infusion pumps; vascular access products; IV solutions; generic injectable drugs

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, health systems, alternate-site infusion providers, group purchasing organizations, pharmacies

revenue_model.value: product sales: disposable infusion products, infusion pumps and injectable drugs sold to healthcare providers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures its own infusion devices, disposables and injectable drugs, sold to hospitals and healthcare providers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, and other international markets where its hospital and drug customers operate

specialization.value: related lines: infusion therapy consumables, infusion pumps and systems, and injectable drugs sold to hospitals

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling directly to hospital systems and group purchasing organizations; distributors / dealers: medical supply distributors serving hospitals and alternate-site providers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices needing FDA clearance and injectable drugs under FDA approval and manufacturing rules

notes: Product mix may differ from the current portfolio after past divestitures and acquisitions, so details are best estimates.
